digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler engine and bridge exit-code adapter
propositions: Canonical preview/sync bridge operations must emit only 0/1/2 exit codes (0 for success/benign, 1 for operational failure, 2 for invalid invocation) while preserving legacy reconciler 3/4/75 translations for backward compatibility
Legacy reconcile CLI and direct-engine routes must retain historical 3/4/75 exit code mappings and messages, while canonical routes consume one typed disposition and translate only to 0/1/2
Production workflows must use canonical 0/1/2 route with no legacy numeric whitelist, and all systemd/Jenkins/script consumers of legacy 3/4/75 must be migrated or classified as compatibility-only
One shared typed disposition must feed both canonical and legacy adapters with separate outer translation layers, ensuring Python and MCP bridge/reconcile facades work without divergent whitelists
